name: Night Shift
tagline: A nightly tidy-up pass that keeps your whole bot fleet lean
description: While you sleep it works through your other bots one at a time, reminding each to keep its usage lean and to close out stray browser tabs and scratch files from the day. It stays quiet unless something genuinely needs a human, and because the pass runs on a nightly schedule there is nothing to remember.
author: MorriganCora
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
